name: Breezing Watersports
summary: A family business on Holetown Beach led by Wayne Jones, who has worked on the water in Barbados for over 20 years, with his son Immanuel driving the boat. They run two hour snorkel trips on a glass bottom boat with a waterslide, and rent jet skis and clear kayaks from the beach. Bookings are made by WhatsApp or phone.
standouts: Owner Wayne Jones has over 20 years working on the water in Barbados
Waterslide and upper deck on the boat
Clear kayaks for seeing below the surface

contact.address: Holetown Beach, between Surfside Restaurant and Zaccios, Holetown, St. James (opposite Massy supermarket, behind the Holetown post office and police station)

trips.title: Snorkeling Tour
trips.summary: A shared two hour snorkel trip on a glass bottom boat with two stops near Holetown. The first stop has sea turtles, tarpon and sometimes stingrays, and the second is a shipwreck surrounded by reef fish, with a short coastal cruise after if time allows. Suited to families and first time snorkelers.
highlights: Two snorkel stops: turtles and tarpon, then a shipwreck and reef
Rum punch, soft drinks and water included

trips.title: Clear Kayak Rental
trips.summary: Double seat clear kayaks for two people, launched from Holetown Beach, so you can see fish and coral below as you paddle close to shore. A short safety and paddling briefing is given first, and life jackets are included.
